compute_chamfer_distance: compute the 2D chamfer distance between two point sets using chamfer_distance function
forward_chamfer_distance: run the forward pass of ChamferDistanceFunction to get distances and indices between two point sets
backward_chamfer_distance: compute gradients for chamfer distance using the backward method of ChamferDistanceFunction
review_chamfer_distance_function: review the ChamferDistanceFunction class and its forward and backward methods for 2D point cloud distance
test_chamfer_distance: test the chamfer_distance function with two batched 2D point set tensors of shape BxNx2
